subject: Physics
q: A proton of kinetic energy 1 MeV moves from south to north through a magnetic field directed from west to east and experiences an acceleration of $10^{12}$ m s⁻². Find the magnetic-field magnitude. Take the proton mass as $1.6\times10^{-27}$ kg and charge magnitude as $1.6\times10^{-19}$ C.
hint: First obtain the speed from kinetic energy, then use qvB = ma; the velocity and field are perpendicular.
solution: $K=1\,\text{MeV}=1.6\times10^{-13}$ J, so $v=\sqrt{2K/m}=\sqrt{2}\times10^7$ m s⁻¹. Since $v\perp B$, $B=ma/(qv)=(1.6\times10^{-27}\times10^{12})/(1.6\times10^{-19}\times\sqrt2\times10^7)=0.71\times10^{-3}$ T = 0.71 mT.
